event.distribution_pattern: Distribution was made to a food distributor in MN who further distributed the product to retail stores located in MN, WI, and MI.

products.product_description: Menno Beachy, Cresco, IA Certified Organic Grape Tomato packaged in 1-pint square-shaped clear plastic clamshell containers, UPC 044419310176, 12/1-pint. containers per case.
products.code_info: Lot numbers MB725GT0, MB725GT3, and MB725GT8. These lot numbers only appear on the case label, not on the clamshell label.
products.reason_for_recall: Salmonella Montevideo was isolated in one lot of the grape tomatoes
